housing.summary: Daft.ie has a Bray rentals page; the Residential Tenancies Board states that a security deposit cannot exceed one month of rent. A Bray city-centre one-bedroom average was not grounded.

banking.summary: AIB requires one original current photo ID and one proof of current permanent address; applicants not currently resident in Ireland need two proof-of-address documents.
required_docs: proof of current permanent address issued within the past six months
two proof-of-address documents if not currently resident in Ireland

schools.summary: The Department of Education provides a map-based school finder. No international curriculum offered in Bray was grounded in an opened source.

legal_admin.summary: After arrival, a person instructed to register and intending to remain more than 90 days should create a Customer Service Portal account and book a first-time in-person registration appointment at the nationwide Burgh Quay Registration Office.
legal_admin.registration_step: Book after arrival and attend first-time immigration-permission registration at Burgh Quay within 90 days.

tax_finance.summary: Apply online for a Personal Public Service Number through MyWelfare using a MyGovID account and provide identity, address, and evidence of why the number is needed.

transport.summary: Transport for Ireland is the public-transport network. The opened fare page did not explicitly identify a Bray-specific monthly product, so no monthly price is recorded.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A licence can be exchanged only if issued by an EU/EEA country or another recognised state; otherwise a resident who wants to drive must follow the Irish learning-to-drive process. Source: https://www.ndls.ie/licensed-driver/exchange-my-foreign-driving-licence.html
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply online to the HSE for a medical card or GP visit card, providing PPS numbers, dates of birth, and income and expense details. Source: https://www2.hse.ie/services/schemes-allowances/medical-cards/applying/apply/
